pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped dark brown polygons with serrated, high-contrast edges. The geometry varies from roughly quadrilateral to complex dendritic shapes. Edge gradients are sharp in the central focal area, with slight blurring at the periphery.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A dense network of cream-colored interstitial lines forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. Pathway thickness is narrow, maintaining consistent pixel width throughout the visible mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dark, bristly mane is visible along the upper neck, presenting a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged contour against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of four oxpeckers (Buphagus sp.) distributed across the neck and upper flank regions.
